content.outro: Ide Fenwick goes down the moor road with her pack on her back. The watch-house at Greyholt is yours now.
content.premise: Greyholt is a stone watch-house on the moor road, and Ide Fenwick has kept it for thirty winters. She is going down to the valley at last, and the new watch has come up to take the post. The post goes with its sword, and the sword is on the rack in the armoury.
content.theme: A watch-house armoury where everything hangs or stands where the watch left it.
content.title: The Armoury
